criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Leave household” on their own profile page. Expected System Behavior: A confirmation appears: “Leave [Household name]? Your open chores will become unassigned.” with “Leave” and “Cancel.”
User Action: Clicks “Cancel.” Expected System Behavior: The confirmation closes, and nothing changes.
User Action: Clicks “Leave.” Expected System Behavior: The user is removed from the household, and the “Your household” screen opens with options to create or join a household.

System state: The user has open chores when they leave. Expected System Behavior: Those chores stay on the Chore List marked “Unassigned.” Any housemate can assign an unassigned chore, the same as a first assignment (see SCRUM-6).
criteria.note: Any housemate can assign it with the pencil: while a chore is unassigned, everyone may edit it (Anthony, 2026-11-22; README Conflicts row 53).

criteria.text: System state: The user has completed chores when they leave. Expected System Behavior: Those chores stay in the household’s chore history with the user’s name.

System state: The user is the household manager. Expected System Behavior: The role passes on following the SCRUM-62 rules: the next highest nominee is invited, or the household returns to the no-manager state.
criteria.note: Waits on SCRUM-62: there are no household managers or nominees yet. Until then the owner stands in, and an owner who leaves isn't replaced (Anthony, 2026-11-22; README Conflicts row 54).

criteria.text: System state: The user has voted or been nominated for household manager. Expected System Behavior: Their vote and any votes for them are cleared.
criteria.note: Waits on SCRUM-62: there are no votes or nominations yet.

criteria.text: System state: The user leaves. Expected System Behavior: Remaining housemates are notified: “[Name] left the household.” The user no longer appears in the House tab roster or the “Assigned to” list.
criteria.note: Not designed yet: the notice is a toast, shown once to each housemate the next time they use the app (README Conflicts row 52).

criteria.text: System state: The user is the only member of the household. Expected System Behavior: The confirmation instead reads: “You’re the last member of [Household name]. Leaving will delete the household and all of its chores.” Confirming deletes the household.
User Action: A former member opens a new invite link to the same household. Expected System Behavior: They can rejoin as a new member. Their past completed chores remain in history.
Error Condition: Leaving fails. Message: “Something went wrong. Please try again.” The user stays in the household.
